summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.98/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.98 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since June 2. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.11 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.66) and the highest in Superior ($4.26).
